ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central and distal areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous perimeter along the leading and trailing edges, with a large concentration in the axial region surrounding the median notch. Small dark focal spots are distributed throughout the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 80 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary; amplitude variations range from 2 to 10 pixels, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge originating from the notch, transitioning into a convex sweep at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected across the white regions of both lobes, including a dense grouping on the lower-left lobe and scattered clusters on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of thin, dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark spotting/mottling across white fields; visible irregular edge chipping on the distal portion of the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, thick black vertical streak extending from the trailing edge into the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.
